search.purpose: Search GitHub issues by free-form qualifier query string and return ranked smart-id results.
when_to_use: User asks to find issues by labels, state, or text without knowing the issue number
Disambiguating between similarly-titled issues across repositories
limitations: Search index lags upstream by up to 60 seconds
Returns at most 30 ranked results per call (GitHub Search API limit)
search.parameter_overview: Required: query (GitHub search qualifier string, e.g. 'is:issue label:bug'). Returns: ranked array of smart-id results.

fetch.purpose: Fetch a single GitHub issue, pull request, or release by smart-id and return its full representation.
when_to_use: Smart-id already known from a prior search() or list_objects() call
Need full body, labels, and timeline metadata not exposed in list views
limitations: Single-object fetch only; for batch reads use list_objects()
Returns 404 if the smart-id refers to a deleted resource
fetch.parameter_overview: Required: id (smart-id of format github-v3-rest-api:{type}:{collection}:{identifier}). Returns: full upstream object.

list_collections.purpose: List the available GitHub collections (Issue, PullRequest, Release) for discovery.
when_to_use: Discovering what types of data this server exposes before issuing list_objects() calls
Building a collection picker in a UI
limitations: Returns only collection metadata, not the objects themselves
Counts are upstream-best-effort; do not rely on exact accuracy
list_collections.parameter_overview: No required parameters. Returns: array of collection descriptors with name and approximate object count.

list_objects.purpose: List GitHub objects in a given collection with page-number pagination, scoped to a repository.
when_to_use: Browsing all issues, pull requests, or releases in a repo
Walking large datasets via per_page + page cursor
limitations: Default page size is 25, max 100 per call
Repo scope is mandatory; cross-repo listing is not supported by GitHub REST
list_objects.parameter_overview: Required: collection (Issue/PullRequest/Release), owner, repo. Optional: limit, cursor (page number). Returns: paged smart-id results.

upsert.purpose: Create a new GitHub issue, pull request, or release in a repository.
when_to_use: Filing a new bug from collected user input
Opening a PR to merge a feature branch into main
when_not_to_use: Closing or merging an existing issue/PR — use issues_close or pull_requests_merge
limitations: Upstream rejects creates that violate branch protection or required-reviewer rules
PRs require head + base branches to exist already (use create_pr_from_branch workflow if branch needs lookup)
upsert.parameter_overview: Required: data (object payload), owner, repo. Returns: created object with smart-id.

delete.purpose: Permanently delete a GitHub release by smart-id.
when_to_use: Removing a draft release that was published in error
Cleaning up auto-generated releases from CI experiments
limitations: Only release deletion is supported; issues and PRs cannot be hard-deleted via REST
Deletion is irreversible; download counts are lost
delete.parameter_overview: Required: id (release smart-id), owner, repo. Returns: confirmation envelope.

issues_close.purpose: Close a GitHub issue by setting state=closed via PATCH.
when_to_use: Resolving an issue after the underlying bug ships a fix
Bulk-closing stale issues during triage
limitations: Already-closed issues return their terminal state without further action
Locked issues cannot be re-closed; verify lock state first
issues_close.parameter_overview: Required: owner, repo, issue_number, state. Returns: updated issue object.

pull_requests_merge.purpose: Merge an open pull request using the specified merge method.
when_to_use: Finalizing a reviewed and approved PR
Automating merges from CI on green checks
limitations: PR must be in mergeable state (no conflicts, required reviews satisfied)
merge_method must match repository policy (some repos enforce squash-only)
pull_requests_merge.parameter_overview: Required: owner, repo, pull_number. Optional: merge_method (merge/squash/rebase). Returns: merge result.

releases_create.purpose: Create a new GitHub release for a given tag.
when_to_use: Publishing a new versioned release after a successful CI build
Cutting a draft release for upcoming changelog work
limitations: tag_name must already exist in the repo or be specified as a target_commitish
Cannot recreate a release for a tag that already has one
releases_create.parameter_overview: Required: owner, repo, data (with tag_name). Returns: created release object.

create_pr_from_branch.purpose: Resolve a branch SHA and open a pull request against the target base in a single workflow.
when_to_use: Opening a PR when only the branch name is known and the head SHA must be looked up first
Automating the resolve+open flow from CI/scripts
limitations: Branch must exist on the repo; resolution returns 404 otherwise
Reports partial failure if PR creation fails after SHA resolution succeeds
create_pr_from_branch.parameter_overview: Required: owner, repo, branch (head). Returns: opened PR object on success; partial-failure envelope on PR open error.
